description: Election Commission - Declare that W. G. S. Kulathunga as a member of the Nuwaragampalatha Central P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member, including the requirement for the political party to nominate a replacement and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters.
